high_level_description: The image is an infographic that provides information about the prevalence of malaria globally, with a focus on sub-Saharan Africa. The title at the top reads: "Malaria is rare in most of the world except sub-Saharan Africa." Below the title, there is a statistic that states: "In 2022, there were a staggering 249 million malaria cases and 608,000 deaths—mostly in Africa."
